title: Remote Storage Health And Circuit Breaker
problem: Remote storage failures are classified and bounded in process-local paths, but backend health is not yet a durable contract that can protect scan, probe, playback staging, and operator diagnostics consistently.

evidence.summary: Opened the durable remote storage health lane, linked it from storage architecture indexes, and split the first executable proof at the repository contract before runtime policy and Admin controls.

Added durable Storage Backend Health records, repository trait, SQLite/PostgreSQL adapters, baseline schema, facade dispatch, and repository contract tests without changing playback staging, cache repair, or Admin routes.

Wired server storage runtime paths to durable Storage Backend Health updates and durable Storage Circuit Breaker admission across read, stream, staging, write, link-plan, apply, cleanup, and restore paths without changing schema, Admin routes, playback staging, or scan scheduling.

Exposed paginated redaction-safe durable Storage Backend Health through Admin storage diagnostics and added an operator reset route that clears Storage Circuit Breaker state through StorageDiagnosticsAppService and the durable repository contract.

Verified final storage health, Admin storage, API, formatting, JSON, and whitespace gates; closed the lane and deferred cache repair, fingerprint escalation, playback artifact I/O scheduling, scan scheduling, and PostgreSQL runtime harnesses to follow-on workstreams.

continue_policy.notes: The durable remote storage health and circuit breaker lane is closed. Open follow-on workstreams for cache repair, source fingerprint escalation, playback artifact I/O scheduling, scan scheduling, or PostgreSQL runtime harness work.
